name: d4ec582c-034b-4126-83e6-057bf1b77a35
description: Comcast Xfinity Internet Repair application with AOS Cloud Run integration

schema.default:
"A customer is contacting support regarding a potential issue with their internet service. Investigate the following devices and identify the root cause, if any, and the appropriate dispatch decision.
"
   "Devices in the customer's home: {mac_addresses}

"
   "Respond ONLY with valid JSON — no extra fields.
"
    "Use EXACTLY this structure:
"
    "{{
"
    "Analysis": "<high-level summary: scope, impairment pattern, and root cause only — no recommendation>",
'
    "Severity": "<Critical | High | Medium | Low>",
'
    "Recommendation": {{
'
    "Technician Type": "<Network Tech | Install and Repair Tech | No Technician Required>",
'
    "Remediation": "<brief action to resolve the issue>"
'
    }}
'
    "}}

"

variableDeclarations.name: accountNumber
variableDeclarations.description: Customer account identifier from telephony platform

variableDeclarations.name: account_id
variableDeclarations.description: Account id is same as accountNumber. It is customers billing account number. it will be cleaned up later

variableDeclarations.name: account_status
variableDeclarations.description: Observable session state capturing account status and flags

variableDeclarations.name: agent_id
variableDeclarations.description: The unique active specialist or orchestrator agent identifier for backend dispatch diagnostics.

variableDeclarations.name: apigee_server
variableDeclarations.description: Dynamic Apigee auth-proxy gateway routing server domain

variableDeclarations.name: channel
variableDeclarations.description: The communication channel (e.g., xfinity, AIQSDK, voice) matching the session type.

variableDeclarations.name: client_wifi_args
variableDeclarations.description: JSON arguments for client wifi analysis tool

variableDeclarations.name: client_wifi_query
variableDeclarations.description: Flat query string for client wifi agent

variableDeclarations.name: convoy_session_id
variableDeclarations.description: Convoy session Id that will be used for EDE integrations and Context Hub calls.

variableDeclarations.name: convoy_tracking_id
variableDeclarations.description: Apigee dynamic routing session tracking identifier for apikey logging.

variableDeclarations.name: current_datetime
variableDeclarations.description: The current date and time for scheduling context

variableDeclarations.name: custGuid
variableDeclarations.description: The unique customer Global Unique Identifier (GUID) matching Comcast's billing record.

variableDeclarations.name: cust_guid
variableDeclarations.description: The unique customer Global Unique Identifier (GUID) matching Comcast's billing record (snake_case).

variableDeclarations.name: gateway_status
variableDeclarations.description: Observable session state capturing gateway telemetry and health metrics

variableDeclarations.name: network_analysis_args
variableDeclarations.description: JSON arguments for network analysis tool

variableDeclarations.name: network_status
variableDeclarations.description: Observable session state capturing network health and recommendations

variableDeclarations.name: network_tool_args
variableDeclarations.description: Tool arguments to call the network test tool

variableDeclarations.name: outage_status
variableDeclarations.description: Observable session state capturing active outage information

variableDeclarations.name: platform
variableDeclarations.description: The customer interface platform type (e.g., web, mobile, IVR) used for tracing.

variableDeclarations.name: triage_args
variableDeclarations.description: JSON arguments for device triage tool

variableDeclarations.name: wifi_status
variableDeclarations.description: Observable session state capturing Wi-Fi troubleshooting outcomes

variableDeclarations.name: wifi_summary_args
variableDeclarations.description: JSON arguments for wifi summary tool

variableDeclarations.name: xa_session_id
variableDeclarations.description: XA Session Id required for calling customer context hub and ede recommendations.

variableDeclarations.name: technician_fee
variableDeclarations.description: Technician service fee variable to avoid hardcoded pricing in instructions.
